description: WhatsApp messages of the tenant's own Twilio sender, AS TWILIO SEES THEM — inbound and outbound, newest first, with delivery status and error code in plain words. This is where a customer's reply shows up even before connect_whatsapp_inbound is set, and where 'sent' turns out to be 'undelivered'. Optional: direction (inbound | outbound | both, default both), number (only the conversation with this E.164 number), since (ISO date), limit (default 20, max 100), include_body (default true). Read-only; twilio_direct tenants. WITH lead_id or contact_id instead: the WhatsApp history of that record from CallPilotAI's own timeline - every route (Beeper, Twilio, AI-Call-Bot), no bridge tool and no Twilio needed.

contact_id.description: History of this contact (timeline), any WhatsApp route.

direction.description: Only inbound, outbound or both (default both)

lead_id.description: History of this lead (timeline), any WhatsApp route.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

since.description: Only entries from this point in time on (ISO 8601)

name: list_whatsapp_messages
